import ipaddress, json, random, subprocess, time
rng=random.Random(3)
def addr(v): return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v))
cases=[]
for c in range(4):
    initial=[["::/0",0]]
    for i in range(1,7000):
        initial.append([addr(i*2**64)+"/64", i%7])
    transactions=[]
    for t in range(3):
        tx=[]
        for i in range(1,2000):
            tx.append(['set', addr((i+t+1)*2**64)+"/64", i%9])
        transactions.append(tx)
    bursts=[{'version':v,'repeat':100,'addresses':[addr(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(60)]}
            for v in range(4) for _ in range(4)]
    cases.append({'initial':initial,'transactions':transactions,'bursts':bursts,'cache_pages':12,
                  'costs':{'hit':1,'miss':17,'decode':[0,1,2]}})
payload=json.dumps({'cases':cases}).encode()
print('input bytes',len(payload))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','submission/main.py'],input=payload,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
dt=time.time()-t
print('rc',p.returncode,'%.2fs'%dt,'stderr',p.stderr.decode()[:300])
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('keys',list(out.keys()))
if 'error' in out: print('invalid')
else:
    for c in out['cases']: print(c['objective'], len(c['versions']))
